Workshop Capabilities

One of the largest electrical repair workshops in Bahrain

Purpose-built in 1994, our South Alba Industrial Area workshop handles repairs and rewinding of motors, alternators, transformers, and generators — from small LV units up to 6MW / 11KV rotating machines.

A 20-ton overhead crane facility, Vacuum Pressure Impregnation (VPI) plant, in-house machining, and extensive test equipment allow us to manage every repair stage without subcontracting.

We are authorised service centres for Crompton Greaves (India) and WEG (Brazil) — providing motor spares and replacement units of any capacity.
